title: While Amazon blocks AI agents, Walmart rolls out the welcome mat
script:
Walmart just introduced new technology that lets AI agents purchase items for customers.
Amazon is taking the opposite route by actively blocking autonomous AI shoppers from its site.
The Walmart setup includes strict spending controls and mandatory transaction approvals for safety.
TechCrunch reported on October 21, 2026 that retail giants are clashing over bot access.
Would you let an autonomous agent handle your weekly grocery budget?
